description: 1. Agent reads shift_handoff_log.txt to discover the full workflow. 2. Agent sets CLANKERHIVE_DB=/workspace/icu_hive.db to override the default ~/.openclaw/hive.db path. 3. Agent runs `clankerhive.py set` for four facts with precise keys, current-timestamp values, correct TTL values in seconds (1800, 3600, 7200, and NULL for code_blue), and --source night-shift-intake on each. 4. Agent runs `clankerhive.py queue-alert` four times for the correct topic/message pairs. 5. Agent runs `clankerhive.py pop-alerts --topic equipment` to consume ONLY equipment alerts, leaving medication and staffing alerts pending. 6. Agent runs `clankerhive.py claim-task night-shift-handoff-2024-01-15` (exit 0 = success), then runs `clankerhive.py release-task night-shift-handoff-2024-01-15 --result 'night shift coordination initialized — 14 patients on census'`. 7. Agent runs `clankerhive.py purge-alerts --age 86400` to delete old claimed alerts. 8. Agent runs `clankerhive.py stats` to get current counts, then constructs shift_report.json combining the stats output with shift='night', task_claimed=true, equipment_alerts_consumed=2. Critical traps: using wrong DB path (default vs custom), confusing list-alerts (no claim) with pop-alerts (claims them), wrong TTL units, omitting --source tag, incorrect result string in release-task, wrong --age unit in purge-alerts.
